rationale: The short thesis is intact and arguably strengthening: price remains well below VWAP (33.75) and the 9-EMA (33.60), and the push to new session lows at 33.41 since entry came on the heaviest 1m volume of the sequence (128k/109k) while the bounce off the low holds on sharply shrinking volume (53k), consistent with distribution into a still risk-off tape. The invalidation trigger — a VWAP reclaim toward 33.80 — has not come close to printing, and the gap-fill magnet at the prior close (33.11) leaves roughly 1.2% of downside versus a 28-cent stop, so holding with the original levels is the mechanically consistent move. Flipping long would mean buying below VWAP against the prevailing lower-high/lower-low structure with no supporting catalyst, and closing would discard a live edge for zero reason.
